Sentences: I have ___ umbrella. ___ umbrella is red.
Step 1: First time we talk about it, so a or an.
Step 2: "Umbrella" starts with a vowel sound, so an.
Step 3: Second time, we both know which umbrella, so the.
So: I have an umbrella.
Your turn. Write a, an or the:
I have a book. ___ book is new.
